_comment: A text node matching one of these is NOT a translation gap. Every entry
names WHY it is exempt, because an unexplained allowlist is how a real gap
gets hidden. Nothing here is prose a reader needs translated.

proper_names.why: Names of companies, platforms, people and tools. Translating them would be wrong.

units_and_currency_codes.why: ISO codes and discipline-standard abbreviations, used identically in Vietnamese financial writing.

identifiers.why: Arm ids, claim ids, amendment ids, artifact filenames, checksums and spec versions are verbatim references into the research record. Translating one would break the reference.

known_exemptions.why: Decorative typography on the paper-spine mark, carrying aria-hidden="true". It is a visual device, not reader copy, and assistive technology skips it.

known_exemptions.text: The decline example is shown. Interaction needs JavaScript.
known_exemptions.why: OPEN GAP, not a false positive. <noscript> content is inert while JavaScript runs, so the i18n runtime can never reach it; with JavaScript off there is no runtime to translate it either. It carries data-i18n="figure.noscript" so a future server-side language pass can fill it. Until then the no-JavaScript fallback is English only. Recorded, NOT claimed fixed.
